overview: This paper introduces Visual Jigsaw, a self-supervised post-training framework using GRPO (Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards) to enhance MLLMs' visual perception by predicting the correct permutation of shuffled visual inputs across image, video, and 3D modalities.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Manages global and modality-specific hyperparameters using structured configurations, including GRPO settings, reward discount factors, data processing thresholds, model paths, and evaluation protocols for different visual modalities.

modules.name: Data Processing: Image Jigsaw
modules.description: Preprocesses image data (e.g., COCO) by filtering small images, partitioning them into 3x3 non-overlapping patches, applying random permutations, and constructing natural language prompts requiring the model to output the raster-scan order.

modules.name: Data Processing: Video Jigsaw
modules.description: Preprocesses video data by filtering short videos, segmenting them into temporal clips, trimming boundary frames to prevent simple matching, applying random permutations to the clips, and generating prompts for chronological order recovery.

modules.name: Data Processing: 3D Jigsaw
modules.description: Processes RGB-D data (e.g., ScanNet) by sampling points with distinct depth values under spatial and depth constraints, annotating shuffled points on 2D RGB views, and generating prompts for nearest-to-farthest depth ordering.

modules.name: Multimodal Dataset & DataLoader
modules.description: Constructs custom PyTorch Datasets and DataLoaders to handle multimodal inputs (image patches, video clips, annotated RGB-D images) and text prompts, supporting efficient batched generation and distributed sampling for RL training.

modules.name: Model Wrapper & Interface
modules.description: Wraps the base MLLM (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct) to handle multimodal inputs, manage generation sampling strategies (e.g., temperature, number of responses), and extract structured answers and reasoning traces from the model's text outputs.

modules.name: Reward Design & Calculation
modules.description: Implements the verifiable reward function for RL training, calculating the graded accuracy reward (exact match, partial match with discount factor, and invalid permutation penalty) and the format reward for correctly structured thinking and answer tags.

modules.name: RL Training Loop (GRPO)
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization training loop, handling batched response generation, reward computation, and policy gradient updates without KL regularization or entropy loss, specifically tailored for the visual jigsaw tasks.

modules.name: SFT Training Loop
modules.description: Implements the Supervised Fine-Tuning baseline training loop for ablation studies, using teacher-forcing on the correct permutation sequences to compare against the RL-based post-training paradigm.

modules.name: Evaluation: Image Modality
modules.description: Evaluates the model on fine-grained perception, monocular spatial understanding, and compositional visual understanding benchmarks using direct answering without CoT, calculating task-specific accuracy metrics.

modules.name: Evaluation: Video Modality
modules.description: Evaluates the model on temporal reasoning and video understanding benchmarks across varying frame settings, calculating accuracy and comparing against baselines that may utilize CoT reasoning.

modules.name: Evaluation: 3D Modality
modules.description: Evaluates the model on 3D spatial reasoning benchmarks involving single-view, multi-view, and egocentric video inputs, computing accuracy on depth comparison and spatial relation tasks.

modules.name: Ablation & Sensitivity Framework
modules.description: Provides scripts to conduct ablation studies comparing SFT vs. RL, varying jigsaw difficulty (grid sizes, clip counts), testing harder configurations, and evaluating transferability to stronger base models and reasoning-oriented MLLMs.

modules.name: Logging, Monitoring & Persistence
modules.description: Integrates with experiment tracking tools (e.g., Wandb/TensorBoard) to log training rewards, policy metrics, and evaluation scores, while managing model checkpoint saving, loading, and inference export.
